content.text: If you're a digital creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or other regions where Stripe and PayPal are restricted, you know the frustration of being locked out of the global economy. But what if you could build a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, free from the constraints of traditional payment platforms? This guide will show you how to deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, giving you the freedom to sell your products to anyone, anywhere in the world.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The reason why this infrastructure works is because it's built on open-source technologies like Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, which provide a scalable and secure foundation for your digital store. By using NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies without the need for KYC or buyer accounts. This stack is designed to be sovereign, meaning you own [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-courses-without-teachable-stripe-which-architecture-actually-8|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-beats-online-11|Everything You]]-you-need-know-about-automated-ebook-delivery-9|everything]] after deployment, with no platform dependencies or subscriptions required.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your crypto store, you'll need to have a clear understanding of your products, pricing, and target audience. You'll also need to set up a Cloudflare account and configure your domain settings. Additionally, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account and generate an API key, which will be used to integrate crypto payments into your store. With these prerequisites in place, you can begin deploying your stack, either by following the Sovereign Blueprint or by purchasing the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and having it deployed for you in 48 hours.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure your Cloudflare Workers to handle crypto payments and integrate with NOWPayments. This will involve writing a few lines of code to handle payment verification and product delivery. You'll also need to set up a Supabase database to store your orders and customer information. With this pipeline in place, you'll be able to accept crypto payments and deliver products automatically, without the need for manual intervention.
Deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack and start accepting crypto payments in 48 hours or less.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your stack is deployed and configured, you can go live and start processing transactions. This will involve testing your payment pipeline to ensure that it's working correctly, and making any necessary adjustments to your code or settings. With your store live, you can start promoting your products to your target audience, and begin accepting crypto payments. You'll be able to track your orders and customer information in real-time, using your Supabase database and Cloudflare analytics.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store grows and you start to process more transactions, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to handle the increased load. This will involve upgrading your Cloudflare plan, adding more Workers to handle payment processing, and optimizing your Supabase database for performance. With the right scaling strategy in place, you'll be able to handle thousands of transactions per day, without sacrificing performance or security. You can find more information on scaling your store at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html

Either way, you'll be able to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies and deliver products automatically, without the need for traditional payment platforms or subscriptions.
Say goodbye to platform dependencies and subscriptions, and take control of your digital store.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your crypto store, follow these steps: set up a Cloudflare account and configure your domain settings, create a NOWPayments account and generate an API key, deploy your stack using the Sovereign Blueprint or the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), configure your Cloudflare Workers to handle crypto payments, set up a Supabase database to store your orders and customer information, test your payment pipeline and make any necessary adjustments, and go live and start promoting your products to your target audience.
